$comment: The config surface, as one machine-readable list: every environment key the repo reads or
documents, grouped by the feature that owns it, and what turning each feature on requires.
An agent or a setup wizard configures the product from this file; a README cannot fail a build.
every key in .env.example, the Joi schema, the web env module, vite.config.ts, the compose files
and the process.env reads it scans must sit in exactly one group or in `waived`, a key listed here
must still exist somewhere, and the Joi cross-rules and production requirements must agree with
Values and defaults are NOT copied here: .env.example and Joi hold them, and a second copy would
be one more thing to drift.
Group fields: `kind` is `core` (always on), `presence` (on when `toggle` is non-empty), `select`
(`toggle` picks an implementation) or `flag` (`toggle` is a boolean). `secrets` are keys holding
secret material, which may never be `VITE_` (those are baked into the public bundle). `required`
are keys Joi refuses to boot without in every environment, and `prodRequired` those it requires in
production only. `services` are compose services the group adds, each of which must exist in a

server.description: The api process itself: port, mode, logging, proxy trust, CORS, the public origins and the app time zone.

database.description: Postgres: the connection, pool sizing and timeouts, and the compose credentials.

redis.description: Redis: sessions, cache, BullMQ, the throttler and the socket.io adapter.

security.description: CSRF, encryption at rest and the TOTP issuer label.

retention.description: How long the retention crons keep audit rows and soft-deleted users.

email.description: Outbound mail. EMAIL_PROVIDER picks smtp (nodemailer, Mailpit in development) or resend.

google-signin.description: Google sign-in. Leave both client keys empty and the provider registers as disabled.

turnstile.description: Cloudflare Turnstile. The dev keys are Cloudflare's always-pass test keys; production must set both halves.

sentry-web.description: Web error reporting. A build argument, inlined into the bundle; empty disables it.

sentry-api.description: Api error reporting. Empty disables it entirely, with zero egress.

otel.description: OpenTelemetry trace and metric export. Empty disables the SDK.

web-dev.description: Development-only web knobs, read by apps/web/vite.config.ts at config time and never bundled.

seed.description: The database seeds: the admin and member accounts and the dev playground.

crossRules.why: A half-configured OAuth client is never valid, so setting one without the other fails boot.

Selecting the resend transport without its key would boot and fail on the first email. Joi does not enforce it yet: the key is optional(). Flip enforcedAtBoot to true in the same change that adds the Joi .when, and the alarm then holds the two together.

waived.ISOLATION_CANARY_DISABLE_MODEL: A test-only seam, not configuration: Joi forbids it outside NODE_ENV=test and only the isolation canary sets it.
waived.HOME: Set by the operating system, not by a deployment: the api's Sentry scrubber reads it to redact the home directory from error events.
waived.USERPROFILE: Set by the operating system (the Windows home directory), not by a deployment; read by the same Sentry scrubber.
waived.USER: Set by the operating system, not by a deployment: the api's Sentry scrubber reads it to redact the OS user name.
waived.USERNAME: Set by the operating system, not by a deployment: the api's Sentry scrubber reads it to redact the OS user name.
waived.LOGNAME: Set by the operating system, not by a deployment: the api's Sentry scrubber reads it to redact the OS user name.
